node_definition.done_when: done when the instrument and the sampler are committed as one module, scripts/census/monitor_census.py , beside death_census.py and carryover_census.py , with a co-located test, scripts/census/test_monitor_census.py . The test runs the instrument on a synthetic stream holding one row of each counted kind, the three halted kinds included, beside a synthetic run directory for the halted runs, and asserts each count is 1. Kinds 2 and 3 cannot be read from a stream row alone, so that directory holds the attempt-N.claim files whose mtimes place a claim before the halted row, and a status-repair.json whose repaired_at falls within 60 seconds before it. It feeds the sampler a synthetic snapshot with a review-missing duty beside a live review pointer for the same run, and requires a count of 1 with both records copied. Three snapshots each require 0: one whose review pointer is absent, one whose review pointer is in the queued phase, and one whose review pointer was granted the record for an older head than the duty names. The last two are the cases where the looser reader would count 1. A fourth snapshot, whose computed_at precedes the live review pointer's launched_at , requires a defect count of 0 and a stale_snapshot count of 1. Negative control, run by this node on the fleet node over the 48 hours ending 2026-10-23T12:37Z, before any of this plan's repairs reached a producer. Under the first kind it must count every carried halted row with process_alive: true , broken down by from-state and to-state. The fifth content review measured 38 over that window, and §1's 24 working → running ( recovered-unwritten ) rows are one key among them. It must also count §3's recorded row ( r-20261023T012524464845-a-plan-write-refuses-the-bucket , 12:25:51Z in the reckon stream) under the second halted kind, and count §4's repair row (12:14:49Z) under the third. A figure that reads zero on that window cannot see its mechanism. Write paths: the module, its test, and this node's evidence fragment, docs/evidence/fragments/a-live-worker-is-never-drawn-halted/census-instrument.html , which records the negative control. The report node ( census-report ) runs after the coordinator's sampler job has ended. It is done when its report covers the 24 hours the sampler covered after the last producer reload, run on the fleet node, and records the following, each figure beside the census in §1: zero carried halted rows of each of the three kinds; at most one lift-granted per lift id; zero same-word wait rows; zero review-missing duties counted as the defect, with the stale_snapshot count stated beside it. Its one write path is its own evidence fragment, docs/evidence/fragments/a-live-worker-is-never-drawn-halted/census-report.html . The landing beat folds both fragments into docs/evidence/archive/a-live-worker-is-never-drawn-halted-landed.html .
